title: Normal Operation
fullDescription: Heil heat pumps flash once for standby. No fault.

title: High Pressure Switch Trip
fullDescription: Can occur in cooling (dirty condenser) or heating (iced outdoor coil / failed defrost).

fixSteps.title: Inspect coil
fixSteps.instruction: Clean outdoor coil, confirm fan runs.

title: Low Pressure / Loss of Charge
fullDescription: Usually a leak or severely restricted airflow. In winter, can also mean iced outdoor coil.

fixSteps.title: Schedule leak test
fixSteps.instruction: Pro finds and repairs leak, then recharges.

title: Reversing Valve Fault
fullDescription: System expected mode change but pressures/temperatures don't confirm it. Stuck solenoid or failed coil.
symptoms: AC instead of heat or vice versa

title: Defrost Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Outdoor coil sensor out of range.
fullDescription: Without a valid coil temperature the defrost board cannot initiate or terminate defrost. System runs on timer fallback.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Clip on suction elbow, plug to board.

title: Compressor Lockout
shortDescription: Compressor locked out after multiple protection trips.
fullDescription: After multiple HPS/LPS trips the board locks the compressor out. Must be cleared by power cycle.

title: Outdoor Fan Fault
fullDescription: Fan failure quickly leads to HPS trip. Check capacitor and bearings.

title: Low Incoming Voltage
fullDescription: Line voltage below ~197V. Utility or wiring issue.
symptoms: Unit won't start in afternoon heat
